name: pdf-audiobook
description: Local-first PDF to read-along audiobook video generator (Apple Silicon optimized)

scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @app/api build && pnpm --filter @app/cli build && pnpm --filter @app/web build
scripts.dev: pnpm build:packages && concurrently -n packages,api,worker,web -c gray,blue,magenta,green "tsc -b -w --preserveWatchOutput packages/pipeline" "pnpm --filter @app/api dev" "pnpm --filter @app/api dev:worker" "pnpm --filter @app/web dev"
scripts.doctor: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @app/cli exec node dist/main.js doctor
scripts.audiobook: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @app/cli build >/dev/null && node apps/cli/dist/main.js create
scripts.audiobook:create: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @app/cli build >/dev/null && node apps/cli/dist/main.js create
